description: This PHP source file is part of the SuiteCRM project and provides administrative functionality for repairing JavaScript files. It includes access control, outputs HTML and JavaScript code for a frontend repair process, and contains inline JavaScript that manages AJAX requests for file repair tasks.

methods.name: callJSRepair
methods.description: JavaScript function that initiates an AJAX request to repair JavaScript files in the admin module, updating the UI based on success or failure.
